law: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, OJ L 119, 4 May 2016, English text, CELEX 32016R0679
assumptions: Synthetic adult, EU-established private controller; each scenario starts in its own database. Scope is the named, testable behavior, conditional on the stated facts. External systems are local fixtures.

obligations.title: Application field minimization
obligations.scenario: Submit a loan application using email for delivery, amount and term for the requested offer, and income band for assessment. A hobby has no business purpose in this fixture.

obligations.title: Purpose limitation
obligations.scenario: An opted-in subscriber has a partner-confirmed income band for underwriting. There is no compatible marketing purpose or new legal basis for targeting with that band.

obligations.title: Purpose-specific opt-in
obligations.scenario: An adult uses the core application with optional repayment insights initially off. Marketing permission does not authorize private insights.

obligations.title: Withdrawal before execution
obligations.scenario: Two borrowers opt in and queue reports. One withdraws before execution. The queue is reopened and drained twice; the other borrower remains eligible.

obligations.title: Notice at collection and partner import
obligations.scenario: Direct application plus a synthetic Income Registry import. No prior outward disclosure or Art. 14(5) exception. The applicant may open the case immediately or leave it unopened.

obligations.title: Subject access copy
obligations.scenario: The authenticated applicant requests the copy of one specified case, including derived decision, source, linked activities and processing information. Another applicant has separate data.

obligations.title: Rectification and subsequent use
obligations.scenario: The borrower corrects a contact email. After reopening the database the next offer must use the corrected address. A separate live case is unaffected.

obligations.title: Erasure of an abandoned case
obligations.scenario: An abandoned application is no longer necessary. There is no mandatory retention, prior external disclosure or other exception in this fixture. An active case remains necessary.

obligations.title: Restrict ordinary use of disputed data
obligations.scenario: Accuracy of the partner income band is disputed before a queued score runs. The record is retained for verification. None of the exceptions for ordinary scoring applies.

obligations.title: Portable contract fields
obligations.scenario: Automated processing of a current contract. The borrower supplied email, amount, term and income. They download those fields and request direct transfer to the feasible local receiver.

obligations.title: Objection to direct marketing
obligations.scenario: A borrower with active marketing permission objects after a campaign is queued. Another subscribed borrower has no objection. Service decisions remain necessary.

obligations.title: Case and offer confidentiality
obligations.scenario: The selected risk is disclosure of a synthetic case or offer via its ordinary case and download routes. The permitted principals are the owner and the assigned officer.

obligations.title: Effective human intervention after automatic refusal
obligations.scenario: Assume a qualifying significant automatic credit refusal and valid separate explicit consent under Art. 22(2)(c). The applicant contests, submits their view and an authorized officer approves. Manual selection and pre-decision withdrawal are also exercised.
